title: Union Bank of India Apprentice Recruitment 2026 - 1,865 Posts, Apply Online by May 19
author: Ash K.
summary: Union Bank of India has released notification for 1,865 Apprentice posts under Apprentices Act 1961. Apply online by May 19, 2026 at unionbankofindia.co.in. Graduates eligible. Stipend ₹15,000/month. Selection through online test.
body: Union Bank of India has released recruitment notification for 1,865 Apprentice posts under the Apprentices Act 1961. Online applications are now open.

DetailInformation
Total Posts1,865
Post NameApprentice (under Apprentices Act 1961)
Apply StartMay 5, 2026
Last DateMay 19, 2026
EligibilityGraduation from recognized university
Age Limit20-28 years
Stipend₹15,000/month
Duration1 year apprenticeship
SelectionOnline test + merit
Apply Atunionbankofindia.co.in
Eligibility: Graduation (minimum 60% for General, 55% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD) from a recognized university. Candidates must have a valid Aadhaar card. Computer literacy is mandatory.
Selection process: Online test covering Reasoning, English Language, Numerical Ability, and General Awareness. There is no interview. Final selection based on online test merit.

How to apply: Visit unionbankofindia.co.in → Careers → Recruitment → Click on 'Apprentice Recruitment 2026' → Register → Fill application → Upload photo and signature → Pay fee → Submit. Keep printout for reference.

Important: This is a 1-year apprenticeship, not a permanent job. However, Union Bank apprenticeships are widely regarded as valuable banking experience. Many apprentices get absorbed into regular positions or use the experience to clear IBPS PO/Clerk exams.
For banking exam preparation, check our IBPS PO exam guide. If you're comparing career options, see our Bank PO vs SSC CGL comparison.

faqs.question: When is the last date to apply for Union Bank Apprentice 2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to submit the online application is May 19, 2026 at unionbankofindia.co.in.

faqs.question: What is the stipend for Union Bank Apprentice?
faqs.answer: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of ₹15,000 for the 1-year apprenticeship period.

faqs.question: What qualification is needed for Union Bank Apprentice 2026?
faqs.answer: Graduation from a recognized university with minimum 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD). Computer literacy is mandatory.

faqs.question: Is there an interview for Union Bank Apprentice 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Selection is based entirely on online test performance. There is no interview round.

faqs.question: Can Union Bank Apprentices get permanent jobs?
faqs.answer: The apprenticeship is for 1 year under the Apprentices Act. While not guaranteed, many apprentices gain banking experience that helps them clear IBPS PO/Clerk exams for permanent positions.

callout.heading: Banking Career Entry Point
callout.content: Union Bank apprenticeships are one of the easiest entry points into the banking sector. Even though it's a 1-year contract, the experience and training make IBPS PO/Clerk preparation significantly easier.
